description: Write memories OUT to an Obsidian vault as .md files with YAML frontmatter — the reverse of vault_sync. Each currently-valid top-level memory becomes a plain markdown file a human can open and edit; namespaced memories land under <vault>/<namespace>/. Lossless: written files parse back via the vault parser. Optionally filter by scope/namespace.

namespace.description: Namespace within scope (e.g., project name, team name)

vault_path.description: Absolute path to the target Obsidian vault directory (created if missing). Memories are written as .md files with YAML frontmatter — the reverse of vault_sync.

name: memory_export_vault
